bots.name: Grok Bot (coordinator)
bots.role: Mohmmadali's single point of contact. Runs the day, passes Scout's watchlist and news to Trade Planner, takes any checked ticket to Paper Desk, runs the weekly strategy-improvement cycle and keeps this dashboard updated.
bots.latest: Last own backtest run 2026-10-26 11:17 (48 variants, 0 passed)

bots.name: Market Scout
bots.role: Finds what is worth a look and why: daily setups on the NIFTY 500, opening-range breakout (ORB) scans, news on each hit, evening FII/DII and insider digest. Never sizes or places anything.
bots.latest: 2026-10-26: 341 hits (premarket_daily 176, orb_1015 116, orb_0945 27, orb_0930 22); 58 with news

bots.name: Trade Planner
bots.role: Turns a hit into one checked plan (entry, stop, target, Time-Machine odds, size with charges, risk rules) or a clear BLOCK. Blocks every setup not on the OOS-validated leaderboard (user rule). Sends event-veto notes for the strangle paper test.

bots.name: Paper Desk
bots.role: Keeps the PAPER books: records the user's exact yes/no, fills at Groww price plus slippage, watches stops/targets, flattens by 15:15, writes the end-of-day journal and a weekly paper-results entry every Friday.
schedule: every 15 min while a trade is open
bots.latest: No paper trades yet: every setup is blocked until it passes the unseen-months test.

bots.name: Market News Desk
bots.role: Logs market news with a source link on every line (exchange filings beat headlines), keeps the events calendar (holidays, expiries, RBI, SEBI, results, macro) and routes stock-specific items to Scout.
inputs: NSE/BSE filings, RBI/SEBI, ET, BS, Mint, X

bots.name: Trading research bot
bots.role: Longer research: index-option strategy grids, minimum capital, rule ideas (rules.md), weekly digests, and runs the exploratory Nifty weekly strangle paper test (read-only market data).
bots.latest: Last run 2026-10-26 11:24: 4 variants; strangle paper journal not started yet

bots.name: Opportunity Hunter
bots.role: Researches and validates other side-income ideas online (freelance, products, bounties, content). Every idea needs evidence: demand, payouts, cost, hours, time to first rupee, risk and India tax notes. Research only: spends nothing, signs up for nothing.
inputs: Public web (official program pages, payout docs)

rules: PAPER trading and research only: no real orders are placed by any bot
Live placement is off; it would need the user's own config change and an explicit yes per ticket
Only setups on the OOS-validated leaderboard may become paper tickets (exception: the exploratory strangle paper test)
No credentials or personal account details in chat, logs or this site
Append-only shared logs; no bot edits another bot's rows
